import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # Только позиции, купленные до seed_time
    items_hist = order_items[order_items["ts"] <= seed_time].copy()
    items_hist["total_value"] = items_hist["price"] + items_hist["freight_value"]

    windows = {
        "7d": 7,
        "30d": 30,
        "90d": 90,
        "365d": 365,
        "all_time": 100000,
    }

    base = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))

    for window_name, days in windows.items():
        if window_name == "all_time":
            window_data = items_hist
        else:
            cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days)
            window_data = items_hist[items_hist["ts"] >= cutoff]

        agg_params = {
            "order_id": ["count", "nunique"],
            "price": ["mean", "sum", "min", "max", "std"],
            "freight_value": ["mean", "sum"],
            "total_value": ["mean", "sum"],
            "seller_id": "nunique",
            "order_item_id": "max",
        }
        if len(window_data) == 0:
            continue
        window_agg = window_data.groupby("product_id").agg(agg_params)
        window_agg.columns = [f"{window_name}_{c1}_{c2}" for c1, c2 in window_agg.columns]
        base = base.join(window_agg, how="left")

    # Временные признаки
    if len(items_hist) > 0:
        time_metrics = items_hist.groupby("product_id")["ts"].agg(["min", "max"])
        time_metrics["days_since_first_purchase"] = (seed_time - time_metrics["min"]).dt.days
        time_metrics["days_since_last_purchase"] = (seed_time - time_metrics["max"]).dt.days
        # Тренд: доля продаж в последних 30 днях от всех продаж
        recent = items_hist[items_hist["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)]
        recent_cnt = recent.groupby("product_id").size()
        total_cnt = items_hist.groupby("product_id").size()
        ratio = (recent_cnt / total_cnt).rename("recent_sales_ratio")
        time_metrics = time_metrics.join(ratio, how="left")
        base = base.join(
            time_metrics[["days_since_first_purchase", "days_since_last_purchase", "recent_sales_ratio"]],
            how="left",
        )

    # Признаки по отзывам: только отзывы, уже созданные к seed_time
    if len(items_hist) > 0:
        prod_orders = items_hist[["product_id", "order_id"]].drop_duplicates()
        rev = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time]
        product_reviews = prod_orders.merge(rev, on="order_id", how="inner")
        if len(product_reviews) > 0:
            grp = product_reviews.groupby("product_id")["review_score"]
            review_agg = grp.agg(["count", "mean", "min", "max", "std"])
            review_agg["five_star_ratio"] = (product_reviews["review_score"] == 5).groupby(product_reviews["product_id"]).mean()
            review_agg["one_star_ratio"] = (product_reviews["review_score"] == 1).groupby(product_reviews["product_id"]).mean()
            review_agg.columns = [f"review_{c}" for c in review_agg.columns]
            base = base.join(review_agg, how="left")

    # Признаки по платежам: только платежи, совершённые к seed_time
    if len(items_hist) > 0:
        prod_orders = items_hist[["product_id", "order_id"]].drop_duplicates()
        pay = payments[payments["ts"] <= seed_time]
        product_payments = prod_orders.merge(pay, on="order_id", how="inner")
        if len(product_payments) > 0:
            pay_agg = product_payments.groupby("product_id").agg(
                payment_count=("payment_sequential", "count"),
                payment_avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
                payment_max_installments=("payment_installments", "max"),
                payment_avg_value=("payment_value", "mean"),
                payment_total_value=("payment_value", "sum"),
            )
            pay_agg["payment_credit_ratio"] = (product_payments["payment_type"] == "credit_card").groupby(product_payments["product_id"]).mean()
            base = base.join(pay_agg, how="left")

    base = base.fillna(0)
    base = base.loc[:, ~base.columns.duplicated()]
    base = base.reindex(entity_ids)
    return base
